_comment: Source of truth for this repo's launchd agents. `toolkit agents install`
launchd does not expand ~ or $HOME inside a plist, so absolute paths are
substituted here at render time: {{REPO}} and {{HOME}}.

agents.name: cindex-refresh
agents.description: rebuild cindex indexes for every code folder in ~/Workspace

agents.name: worklog
agents.description: write the daily work log from the session index and git commits
